entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I wasn't expecting anything as grand[n]as this.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: This can't be standard fare for high[n]school couples, can it?
Yup.
We don't need 'standard.'

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I had no idea. You've certainly opened[n]my eyes...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: A fine point, well made.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: As long as I know I'm in your heart,[n]I'll be happy.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: *giggle* ...That confidence suits you.[n]I see traces of my valiant partner[n]in the great wars of shogi.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: And, perhaps... a partner I can rely on[n]in my life beyond the board.
Thanks.
I'm happy to hear that.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's only fitting that I devote myself[n]to supporting you in turn.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'm sorry... Please, excuse me a[n]moment.
When should I give her the gift?
○○○ is calling me...
I can't answer this now...!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Is that your phone? If there's some[n]kind of emergency, please...
It's not a big deal.
Don't worry about it.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: If you insist...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Apologies for the wait.

entries.speaker: Announcer
entries.en: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for[n]joining us on this special day.

entries.speaker: Announcer
entries.en: We wish you all an unforgettable[n]evening, with one last finishing touch[n]from us...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: What could this be?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...It's wonderful...
I have a gift for you.
I want you to have this.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Are you sure about this...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Thank you so much...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: The restaurant alone was stunning, but[n]you even got me a beautiful gift...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I... don't know how to thank you.
I'm glad you liked it.
You don't need to thank me.
Surprise.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'll make it up to you, starting next year.[n]No... starting now.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Unacceptable.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I'm your girlfriend, aren't I...?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: A surprise indeed. What a perfectly[n]executed maneuver.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You take such good care of other[n]people... You put their needs before[n]your own without a second thought.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's one of the reasons I respect you[n]so much.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: And yet... respect alone isn't enough.[n]One day, I hope I can emulate that[n]selflessness myself.
Thanks.
You're making me blush.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's a goal I can devote myself to.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: But... that can wait until tomorrow,[n]perhaps?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Right now, as long as we don't have[n]a shogi board in the way... the only[n]thing I want to be devoted to is you.
Hifumi and I spent some[n]time alone together...
Once it got late, I walked her[n]back to the station...
